title.narrative: Output 8.3. Increased capacity of Member States to integrate social protection in comprehensive policy responses to support and protect workers and employers during their life and work transitions

description.narrative: The President of Indonesia on 6 October 2023 signed the Second Amendment to the Government Regulation No. 44 of 2015 concerning the Implementation of the Employment Injury Benefit and Death Benefit Programs. The Regulation is intended to provide social security protection for Participants suffering from the risk of Employment injury. The Regulations also provide changes with respect to provision of benefits, reporting, and preventive activities. The ILO has provided inputs to several technical discussions from the OSH perspectives as well as from financing and policy parameters perspectives.

description.narrative: The ILO’s Decent Work Results Dashboard –complementing the ILO’s Programme Implementation Report – presents information on the results achieved and on the most significant outputs delivered by the ILO during the relevant biennium.

title.narrative: The ILO’s Results Framework for the biennium

description.narrative: The ILO’s Results Framework is always part of the Programme and Budget (P&B) document for the relevant biennium. Please refer to the Annex “Results Framework” of the relevant P&B Document

The ILO’s biennial Programme Implementation Report is an instrument of accountability. It describes the performance of the Organization against the commitments made in the Programme and Budget documents for the corresponding biennial period.
